In a legendarily rare celestial event every heavenly body in the solar system aligns with the sun and causes a disturbance in the magical balance of the world. During a harmonic convergence magic is much more potent and mages can cast spells almost effortlessly but the world is very volatile and portals to other worlds open across Terra-Nova (not celestial gates). Elven mages used this power to enact a second Dimensional Expedition (on a smaller scale).
